name: Upper (campus variant, return from illness)

exercises.note: PROVISIONAL loads. 40 was very easy, 55 at RIR 3, 60 x 8 anyway. Not the Hammer Strength at Fitness Park.
7-6-5 bodyweight at constant effort. Best part of the day - no sign of a week off.
PROVISIONAL loads. 50 x 10 twice with 3 in reserve.

exercises.n: Cable lateral raise, single arm, campus
exercises.note: Numbers not reported; prescribed 5 kg x 15. Side delts were at 0 for week 3.
Numbers not reported; prescribed 15 kg x 15. Campus has no reverse pec deck.

notes: First session back after seven days ill (17-22 Sep) and the first upper-body session ever at the campus gym. Deliberately submaximal: RIR 3 throughout, no set to failure, half the usual volume. After 9 sets he said he was still not fully recovered and told me not to treat today's numbers as his working loads. Then he chose to finish: no shoulder press machine at campus, so overhead pressing was dropped and he did 2 x 15 cable lateral raises and 2 x 15 face pulls, light (numbers not reported, logged as prescribed). Every load today is a floor: next campus upper day opens at these numbers and climbs from set 2.
